title: finding(plugin-timeline): `ObjectTimeline` renders a lookup-typed `descriptionField` value as a React child, so an expanded `{ id, name }` crashes the timeline
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named site and a reproduction (class a): a user-reachable render crash. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10456 (PR objectui#10525, which fixes the same defect on `ObjectMap`). ⛔ Not graded and not routed.

## Site (read by the seat on `origin/main` at `efbf18de5`)

`packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx`:
- the item mapping copies the raw value: `description: item[descField]` (and `title: item[titleField]` beside it);
- the component's own object fetch expands every declared relation (`buildExpandFields(objectDef?.fields)`), so a lookup-typed field arrives as an object;
- the timeline renderer puts `item.description` in JSX as a React child.

## Reproduction (the dev's probe, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

A one-shot uncommitted probe at `9eea12a2b` used the real `ObjectTimeline` and renderer with the schema `descriptionField: 'account'`, where `account` is a lookup field and the row carries `account: { id: 'a1', name: 'Acme' }`. It logged `$expand ["account"]` and threw `Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {id, name})`. The bare-id control (`'a1'`) rendered. The probe was deleted.

Read, not measured: `title: item[titleField]` has the same shape for a lookup-typed `titleField`.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The shape of the fix, as PR objectui#10525 did for `ObjectMap`: derive the text once at the mapping site through `@object-ui/core`'s `recordDisplayValueAt` (⛔ no new resolver). An expanded lookup reads as its display name, a bare id as itself, a number or boolean as its string, and an empty value as nothing.
- The pin needs a reach-path case: the component's own fetch expands the lookup, then renders.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18). A timeline description near lookup, "React child" or object ⇒ only PR objectui#10525. `TimelineRenderer` ⇒ 5 unrelated (metaFields, primitive rows, undeclared keys, tombstones, item type). `Objects are not valid as a React child` ⇒ objectui#10456, PR objectui#10525 and unrelated tooltip, slider and chart items. Must-hit control `ObjectTimeline` ⇒ 15 hits.

Dedupe words: `ObjectTimeline descriptionField lookup React child` · `timeline description expanded object crash` · `TimelineRenderer item.description object`
